Apple's September event is fast approaching, with the date most likely to be announced next week. Here are over 10 upcoming new Apple products, most of which are expected to debut in September.

Here are all the new Apple products that may launch at the September event or shortly after.

The annual Apple September event is the company's most important product launch of the year. Although there's always a few surprises, new iPhone and Apple Watch models are almost certain to make their September appearance.

Here are the products we expect this year:

Beyond these safe bets, another potential launch is new AirPods with an infrared camera. Apple often introduces new AirPods at the September event because they're positioned as iPhone accessories.

A video leaked this week from macOS 26.7 showed for the first time AirPods with a camera, suggesting the product may launch soon. However, if Mark Gurman is correct, we won't see this product until 2027.

Additionally, four new Apple Home products are reportedly set to launch as early as next month:

These 10 products are the most likely to be announced in September. However, other possibilities include an OLED-equipped iPad mini, an indoor security camera, and potentially new Macs—though the latter is more likely to arrive in October.

Which upcoming Apple product are you most excited about? Let us know in the comments.
